title: W3C PROV Data Model
bounded_claim: Defines domain-agnostic provenance entities, activities, agents, derivations, responsibility and bundles, with explicit extensibility.
authority_limit: Provenance records support trust assessment but do not themselves prove truth, conformance, sufficiency or acceptance.
negative_twin: provenance relation != causal proof != accepted evidence

title: OpenLineage specification 1.52.x
bounded_claim: Defines observed operational lineage events over Run, Job and Dataset identities with extensible facets and separate job/run/input/output context.
authority_limit: Observed lineage event does not create provenance assertion authority, cryptographic attestation, conformance appraisal or acceptance.
negative_twin: observed lineage event != authenticated attestation != accepted conclusion

title: in-toto Attestation Framework v1.2
bounded_claim: Defines authenticated artifact metadata using independent Predicate, Statement, Envelope and Bundle layers; latest tagged spec is v1.2.
authority_limit: Authenticated metadata establishes issuer-bound claims/integrity properties, not automatic semantic truth or acceptance.
negative_twin: authenticated attestation != verified predicate truth != appraisal

title: ISO/IEC 11179-1:2023 Metadata registries Part 1 Framework
bounded_claim: Defines the conceptual framework for metadata registries and descriptions of data, concepts, meanings and their relationships.
authority_limit: Metadata registry governance does not define every domain ontology, physical encoding or catalog publication lifecycle.
negative_twin: metadata registry entry != domain concept authority != physical representation

title: W3C SKOS Reference
bounded_claim: Defines concept schemes, labels, semantic relations, collections and directional mapping relations including exact/close/broader/narrower/related mappings.
authority_limit: SKOS mapping does not imply OWL logical equivalence, data transformation or master-record identity.
negative_twin: SKOS mapping != schema mapping != entity merge

title: OWL 2 Web Ontology Language
bounded_claim: Defines formal ontology vocabularies with explicit syntax/semantics separation and profiles.
authority_limit: OWL ontology semantics do not define terminology designation governance, code-system lifecycle, metadata catalog or master-data stewardship.
negative_twin: formal ontology != terminology != catalog != master data

title: W3C DCAT 3
bounded_claim: Defines interoperable catalog metadata and separates CatalogRecord, Resource, Dataset, Distribution, DataService and DatasetSeries with versioning support.
authority_limit: Catalog metadata does not own dataset semantic truth, schema meaning, physical representation or service implementation.
negative_twin: catalog record != dataset != distribution != data service

title: WCAG 2.2
bounded_claim: Defines testable accessibility success criteria for web content across perceivable, operable, understandable and robust concerns.
authority_limit: Accessibility conformance does not define visualization grammar, semantic query, metric meaning or application authorization.

title: WAI-ARIA 1.2
bounded_claim: Defines roles, states and properties for accessible UI semantics exposed to assistive technologies.
authority_limit: ARIA roles/states do not define business object state, data semantics or application command authorization.

title: Vega-Lite declarative grammar of interactive graphics
bounded_claim: Defines a declarative visualization grammar with marks, encodings, scales, transforms, composition and interaction compiled to Vega.
authority_limit: Visualization grammar does not own source data, metric/query semantics, disclosure policy or analytical truth.
